selection: Every direct body division in exact source order. Numeric source URLs have one actual h1 and produce encyclopedia-entry; the landing page and 47 letter indexes retain their actual h1 as source_title and headword=null; the separate unavailable-source-members division retains its actual heading and headword=null.
public_native_attributes: Retain CSS/rendition, source HTML tag/attributes, meaningful TEI roles and language; map every TEI xml:id to an injective public alias. Local target/from/to pointers use the same alias only when the actual ID exists; unbound source literals remain explicitly qualified. Retain all original fields in private per-unit event digests. Do not copy TEI xml:id values into public annotations.

special_semantics.spanGrp_span: Exactly one block-spanning emphasis range remains as source-block/source-marker with source_role and explicit aliased from/to fields in source_annotations. Never coerce it into an ordinary inline hi or drop the range.
special_semantics.table_cells: Preserve ordered rows/cells, label-cell role, cols and rows as source_column_count/source_row_count with literal HTML attributes and CSS. Do not flatten the table into definition strings.
special_semantics.graphics: Keep every actual image-reference and figure description. Retained data URIs remain source-bound; nine missing images retain explicit gap descriptions. Undisplayed retained assets remain support evidence rather than invented displayed graphics.
special_semantics.g: Keep the literal source glyph U+0017 carrier reference and visible glyph; no control-character modernization.
special_semantics.publisher_citations: Preserve source citation/transcription/approbation paragraphs in structured content. Article-local Volumes 1-17 are not row order, inferred edition identities or a Volume I scope.
special_semantics.unavailable_register: Retain all seventeen global failure entries and their source URLs, including the six evidence refs unaffected by the seven content-link repairs.

plain_text_policy: Human-readable convenience text follows source text/tail order, with documented block/row/cell delimiters and normalized whitespace. Native mixed content is the complete public structured representation; private event digests account for fields withheld from public rows.
required_schema_change: Add an exact-work native reference-unit branch to reference-entries.schema.json. Preserve the existing dictionary/reference-entry branch unchanged. New branch uses category=reference_entries, row_format, unit_kind, actual source_title, nullable headword for index/register, native structure, locator and ordinary provenance. This schema and the supported reader/assembler/streaming-browser route require root review and a released shared-code window.
no_schema_change_needed_for: Existing native-content kinds and attributes already express the observed grammar using source_role/source_annotations for the cross-block range; no global native-content enum change is proposed.
closed_gate_status: Not projected, schema-valid, independently verified or accepted. Proposed maintained opt-in must validate actual acceptance first and admit only the exact reviewed work/form/edition/master/header/acquisition/runtime.
